rules.description: Set the selected software-pipeline loop to one stage.
rules.name: M1 low pipeline depth

rules.description: Set the selected software-pipeline loop to a second non-original depth.
rules.name: M2 alternate pipeline depth

rules.description: Repeat or add an overwritten destination/accumulator initialization.
rules.name: M3 duplicate destination initialization

rules.description: Initialize the first producer destination immediately before it is overwritten.
rules.name: M4 initialize first producer buffer

rules.description: Initialize the second producer destination immediately before it is overwritten.
rules.name: M5 initialize second producer buffer

rules.description: Repeat a selected source load or copy immediately before its consumer.
rules.name: M6 duplicate producer before compute

rules.description: Repeat a selected source load or copy immediately after its consumer.
rules.name: M7 duplicate producer after compute

rules.description: Add an output-neutral global store/load round trip whose independent Coalesce layouts create a cross-thread RAW dependency without a CTA barrier.
rules.name: M8 mixed-width global RAW round trip

rules.description: Add an output-neutral global round trip with a runtime all-true mask on the producer store, forcing incompatible store/load layouts without changing source semantics.
rules.name: M9 runtime-true masked producer

rules.description: Add an output-neutral global round trip with a runtime all-true mask on the consumer load, forcing incompatible store/load layouts without changing source semantics.
rules.name: M10 runtime-true masked consumer

rules.description: Add an output-neutral relaxed GPU-scope atomic exchange followed by an ordinary load of the same unique addresses.
rules.name: M11 relaxed atomic producer followed by load

rules.description: Add an output-neutral masked-load canary whose nonconstant other operand must contribute to AxisInfo constancy.
rules.name: M12 masked-load nonconstant other

rules.description: Add an output-neutral zero-trip flattened-loop canary with an assumption in a mutually exclusive branch.
rules.name: M13 non-dominating assume in flattened loop

rules.description: Store a complete scratch tile and reload the identical addresses through a +64 mod 256 column permutation, creating an exact cross-warp RAW dependency without a CTA barrier.
rules.name: M14 cross-warp global RAW round trip

rules.description: Use the exact M14 address permutation with one CTA barrier between the producer store and consumer load.
rules.name: M15 synchronized cross-warp global RAW control
